discription: A lead synth sound using a pulse wave with a modulating pulse width, controlled by a low-frequency oscillator (LFO) and an ADSR envelope. This creates a rich, evolving timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, atk=0.01, dec=0.1, sus=0.8, rel=1.0, lfoRate=0.2, pwMin=0.1, pwMax=0.9; var sig, env, pulseWidth; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(atk, dec, sus, rel, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); pulseWidth = SinOsc.ar(lfoRate).range(pwMin, pwMax); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
